title: Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
The Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (SICCAS), established in Shanghai in 1954, is a leading research institute for advanced inorganic materials, spanning structural and functional ceramics, energy materials and biomaterials.

Its aerogel-related research includes ceramic fiber aerogels, silicon carbide aerogels and flexible aerogel fibers, alongside high-temperature thermal protection materials developed for aerospace and industrial energy applications.

The institute publishes extensively on aerogel processing and insulation mechanisms and cooperates with industry partners to transfer porous-material technologies into engineering applications.
excerpt: CAS institute for advanced ceramics with research programs on ceramic fiber aerogels, SiC aerogels and high-temperature thermal protection materials.
